name: Caswallon
text: Caswallon is a child of the great Beli Mawr in Welsh lore. He seizes Britain while Bendigeidfran, the Blessed Bran, is away. He slays every rival lord except Caradog. He restores the honour that Branwen once lost. A cloak of illusion makes him invisible, so he can strike unseen. Through that hidden veil he wields his terrible blade. When he takes the crown in London, Pryderi yields homage to him. The historic chief Cassivellaunus may inform his legend. Celtic sources often call him brother to Arianrhod. Some texts name Lludd as a brother as well. Rachel Bromwich once proposed a lost saga of his wars. His name also appears as Caswallawn and Caswallan.

attributes.attribute: son of Beli Mawr in the Mabinogion tradition
uses a cloak of invisibility in battle

okr.objective: Document the Welsh hero Caswallon as a figure of the Mabinogion
key_results: Record his lineage from Beli Mawr
Describe his conquest of Britain and use of illusion
Trace his ties to Cassivellaunus, Arianrhod and Lludd
